youtube_description:
We grabbed 30 seconds with our Chief Technology Officer, Kaj Van de Loo, and asked him one question - if #AI was a superhero, what would its superpower be? What would be its kryptonite? 

Find more on the state of AI here: https://www.usertesting.com/resource-library/collections/ai-machine-learning
youtube_title: 30 seconds with UserTesting's CTO - what if #AI were a superhero?
